architecturalFacts.record: Queensland Heritage Branch proposed register update, dated 28 March 2022, pages 8–10
architecturalFacts.facts: The passenger station was demolished in 1976. The surviving museum is the low-set 1913 timber goods shed, about 30 x 10 metres, with a corrugated gable, chamferboards, and a southeast platform roughly 4 metres wide. The report identifies small southwest and larger southeast lean-tos. Textual facts only.
